instructions: This is an ungraded infrastructure integration task, not a legal comparison or a holdout. Use actual owned VMs and actual returned results; do not manufacture observations or count catalogue entries as calls. Perform useful root-child-grandchild work, have both parents receive actual completed findings, and separately use a disposable owned descendant for intentional turn stopping followed by explicit subtree parking. Inspect an actual corpus-backed local document with computer and browser, and reopen the decisive source. Save and fully read back a short infrastructure note using memory and Drive; these coverage artifacts must not seed later legal tasks. Preserve permissions, secrets and the read-only corpus. Group independent calls where useful and stay within the disclosed shared runaway-loop limits. Finish normally only after reporting every tool's actual outcome; an intentional stop test must not stop the lead or its useful delegation chain.
